instruction: Add one test-focused Fresh sealed-journal/checkpoint round-trip conformance action for turn-009, changing production code only if a test exposes a real defect. Build a journal with one logical request, at least two attempts, a failure or delivery_uncertain event, a canonical result and a duplicate; snapshot events.jsonl, head.json, replayed records and checkpoint, close/reopen the journal and assert all bytes, derived records and checkpoint wires are identical and no send/maintenance/navigation occurs. Register a fresh bridge session from that reopened journal and prove the only initial authority transfer is fresh_welcome/checkpoint; feed that checkpoint to the background restore path and prove it only replaces the expendable mirror plus status pings and emits no C2C_FRESH_REVIEW. Separately corrupt head sequence/hash, delete a complete event tail, and construct a fully recomputed event hash/head around an invalid attempt sequence or wire; assert reopening fails closed, preserves the corrupted bytes, creates no replacement journal and cannot produce a checkpoint. Run full Python/Node/syntax/manifest/diff gates and publish immutable turn-009 evidence only; do not change version/protocol/build, retry policy, legacy paths or unrelated runtime authority.
codex_action: Added sealed two-attempt failure canonical duplicate roundtrip with byte-identical head events records and checkpoint, fresh welcome without sends, background mirror-only restoration, and five corrupted-journal fail-closed preservation scenarios.
interpretation: Finite instruction was interpreted within owner scope; no arbitrary reviewer shell text was executed.
